property_summary: For any caller whose reentrant supportsToken callback re-enters airDrop, airDrop grants at most one +20 grant per outer call (balance after call is exactly 20 or 0); deleting the reentrancy lock lets the nested call succeed so the caller ends with 40.

For any caller and any re-entrancy depth, a completed airDrop grants exactly one +20 grant (tokenBalance stays 20); deleting the lock lets the nested airDrop succeed so the balance becomes a multiple of 20 greater than 20 (e.g. 40).

For any admissible call, a completed airDrop grants the caller exactly one +20 grant (tokenBalance == 20), but the deleted reentrancy lock lets a reentrant airDrop succeed during the supportsToken check, leaving the caller with 40.

After any airDrop call completes, no address other than the direct caller may have received a credit — the reentrancy lock makes any nested airDrop (routed through a proxy contract, hence a different key) revert in C, but the deleted lock in M lets it succeed, crediting the proxy key with 20.

For any caller, tokenBalance never exceeds 20: airDrop can only be invoked when the caller's balance is exactly 0, so after a successful airDrop any further airDrop by that caller reverts; the mutant allows callers with balance <= 20 to call again, accumulating 40.
